verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is accounting software, so a month-end close checklist is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no close checklist and no tracking of reconciliations, accruals, or review sign-offs. Bank transaction statement filters and automatic transaction matching and categorisation are related features, not a checklist-driven close workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
